designation: IN THE COURT OF DISTRICT & SESSIONS JUDGE
jurisdictionNote: District-level criminal and civil courts in Madhya Pradesh, governed by the Madhya Pradesh Civil Courts Act, 1958 and the M.P. High Court Rules, 2008. Sessions courts try offences punishable with imprisonment exceeding 7 years. Hindi is the official language of the State courts under the M.P. Rajbhasha Adhiniyam, 1957. Current count is 55 districts (Mauganj and Pandhurna notified in 2023-24).

party_designation.state: State of Madhya Pradesh through the Principal Secretary, Home Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh, Bhopal

prayer_language.opening: It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to:
prayer_language.closing: And for this act of kindness, the applicant shall, as in duty bound, ever pray.

verification_format:
I, {deponent_name}, {designation}, do hereby solemnly verify and declare that the contents of the above application from paragraph ___ to paragraph ___ are true to my personal knowledge and the contents of paragraphs ___ to ___ are believed to be true on the basis of information received and legal advice tendered, which I believe to be true. Nothing material has been concealed therefrom.

Verified at {place} on this {date}.

DEPONENT
localRules: Hindi is the official language of the M.P. subordinate courts; pleadings in English are accepted but Hindi translation may be insisted upon under the M.P. Rajbhasha Adhiniyam, 1957.
Bail applications under S.483 BNSS in M.P. are commonly numbered as M.Cr.C. (Miscellaneous Criminal Case).
Anticipatory bail applications (S.482 BNSS) must be accompanied by an affidavit, certified copy of the FIR and grounds of apprehension.
Vakalatnama in the form prescribed under the M.P. High Court Rules, 2008 to be filed at the first instance with requisite court-fee stamp.
All civil pleadings to be paginated, indexed and accompanied by a list of documents under Order VII / Order VIII CPC.
Court-fee under the Madhya Pradesh Court-Fees Act, 1870 as adapted and amended.
Atrocities (SC/ST), POCSO and NDPS cases are tried by designated Special Courts notified by the State Government.

Mauganj district (carved out of Rewa, 2023) and Pandhurna district (carved out of Chhindwara, 2023) follow the notifications issued by the Government of Madhya Pradesh and the M.P. High Court regarding jurisdictional headquarters.
e_filing_note: e-Filing is operational at Bhopal, Indore, Jabalpur, Gwalior and select district HQs via the eCourts portal; not yet mandatory state-wide.
